{{Quote|Sorry. Not interested in wk'ou melons today, thanks.|Wedge Antilles to a Morish trader|<ref name="SpecPast />}}
A '''wk'ou melon''' was a double-bulbous, pale [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Melon/Legends|melon]] sold on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]]. While at a marketplace on Morishim in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was offered a wk'ou melon by a [[Morish]] [[Unidentified wk'ou seller|produce seller]], though he refused her pitch. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was also onworld, meanwhile purchased a wk'ou melon of his own.<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wk'ou melon first appeared in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and released in [[1997]].<ref name="SpecPast" />
